title: Dual-bias SICM imaging (CIHD): lipid patches on mica

permission.note: Preliminary: published here with permission of the data owner (pending).

source: Data: Klausen et al., Nat. Commun. (2016); re-processed.
bias_note: In these 2015 Park XEP files the paper's +100 mV corresponds to header sample bias -0.10 V (pipette potential = -header value). Labels follow the paper.
convention: dh = h(-100 mV) - h(+100 mV); sign of dh = sign of the surface charge relative to the mica substrate.
files: CIHD_<id>_map_{plus100mV,minus100mV,dh}_nm.csv (rows = y, columns = x, nm; registered, oriented and cropped as in the paper)
